title: Uniqueness of Equivariant Building Maps
body_html:
Uniqueness of Equivariant Building Maps

If \(B\) and \(B'\) are two \(G\)-sets satisfying the building axioms over \(k\), then a \(G\)-equivariant bijection \(j:B\to B'\) whose restriction to an apartment is affine is unique up to translation by a vector from the split center. In the anisotropic-center cases used in the paper, the translation ambiguity vanishes.
proof_html:
Extraction

The lemma is recalled from Prasad-Yu/Tits building uniqueness. It is used to certify that explicit norm-level base-change maps are the canonical maps of buildings.
